entities.name: Accenture — Disability Inclusion
entities.description: Global professional services company with published accessibility and employment policies for persons with disabilities and employees with disabilities.
entities.selectionRationale: Selected because Accenture publicly describes equal employment opportunity for persons with disabilities, workplace accommodations, accessibility centres, and disability inclusion within its workforce reporting.
entities.contributionSummary: Provides reasonable accommodations, accessibility policies, employee support for persons with disabilities, and public workforce reporting that includes people who self-identify as persons with disabilities.
entities.insights: Notable for showing how a global professional services company can connect disability inclusion, accessibility practice, workforce reporting, and technology-enabled workplace support.

evidence.description: Official statement covering equal employment opportunity and accommodations for persons with disabilities.
Describes Accenture's accessibility approach and support for persons with disabilities.

entities.name: Microsoft — Disability Hiring Initiative
entities.description: Technology company with accessible hiring, workplace accessibility, neurodiversity hiring, and supported employment resources for candidates and employees with disabilities.
entities.selectionRationale: Selected for demonstrating accessible hiring pathways, workplace accessibility resources, neurodiversity hiring, and supported employment approaches in a major technology workplace.
entities.contributionSummary: Offers accessible hiring support, a Neurodiversity Program, Supported Employment resources, workplace accommodations, accessibility resources, and research into technologies for people with disabilities.
entities.insights: Demonstrates that accessible hiring and neurodiversity-focused pathways can support meaningful technology-sector employment while informing broader accessibility innovation.

evidence.description: Official Microsoft page covering accessible hiring, neurodiversity hiring, supported employment, and accommodations for candidates with disabilities.
Official Microsoft page describing support, accommodations, community, and opportunities for employees with disabilities and neurodivergent employees.

entities.name: Leonard Cheshire Disability
entities.description: UK-based disability organisation providing care, accommodation, information, guidance, employment support, and campaigning for disabled people.
entities.selectionRationale: Selected for demonstrating holistic support for disabled people including employment, housing and community participation, with evidence-based programmes.
entities.contributionSummary: Provides care and accommodation, employment support, information and guidance, and campaigns to remove barriers disabled people face in work and wider life.
entities.insights: Demonstrates that meaningful contribution requires integrated support across employment, housing, and community life—not employment alone.

evidence.description: Official page describing care and accommodation, information and guidance, and employment support.
Campaign page describing barriers disabled people face in work and calls for employment support.

entities.name: Sense — Complex Disabilities
entities.description: UK-based organisation supporting disabled people with complex needs, including people who are deafblind or have multi-sensory impairment.
entities.selectionRationale: Selected for demonstrating specialised support for disabled people with complex needs and for work on communication, independence, community life, arts, sports, and wellbeing.
entities.contributionSummary: Provides personalised support, communicator guides, supported living, education, arts, sports, wellbeing activities, and advocacy alongside disabled people with complex needs.
entities.insights: Shows that meaningful inclusion sometimes requires personalised communication support, flexible services, and work alongside disabled people with complex needs.

evidence.description: Official page describing Sense's work with disabled people with complex needs.
Official page describing community support and communicator guides for disabled people with complex needs.

entities.name: Royal National Institute of Blind People (RNIB)
entities.description: UK-based charity supporting blind and partially sighted people through employment services, education, technology innovation, and advocacy.
entities.selectionRationale: Selected for long-standing leadership in employment evidence, technology access, public attitudes, and advocacy for blind and partially sighted people.
entities.contributionSummary: Provides advice, campaigns, research, employer resources, and technology evidence focused on barriers and opportunities for blind and partially sighted people.
entities.insights: Demonstrates that accessibility innovation benefits broader society—technologies designed for blind users often improve usability for all.

evidence.sourceTitle: RNIB — Employment for Blind and Partially Sighted People in 2019
evidence.description: RNIB research on employment circumstances and barriers for blind and partially sighted people.
RNIB report on technology, inclusion, independence, and digital barriers for blind and partially sighted people.

entities.name: Autistica
entities.description: UK-based research and evidence organisation led by and for autistic people, investigating how to improve health, wellbeing, and independence.
entities.selectionRationale: Selected for demonstrating that autistic people's participation in research, employment planning, and co-produced support can produce more relevant evidence for inclusion.
entities.contributionSummary: Conducts research led by autistic people, provides evidence on effective workplace accommodations and education approaches, and advocates for autistic-led policy.
entities.insights: Shows the value of centering autistic people's knowledge and lived experience in research, employment support, and policymaking rather than treating them only as subjects of study.

evidence.description: Official page describing Autistica's employment research, employer work, and goal to double the employment rate for autistic people.
Research project describing an employment readiness programme co-produced with autistic people, families, employers, and education providers.

entities.name: The Valuable 500
entities.description: Global business collective focused on disability inclusion in business, with hundreds of major organisations making public commitments.
entities.selectionRationale: Selected for mobilising corporate leadership around disability inclusion and demonstrating business case for diversity at scale.
entities.contributionSummary: Convenes major organisations to put disability inclusion on the business agenda and advance disability inclusion across business practice.
entities.insights: Demonstrates that disability inclusion is increasingly recognized as a business imperative by mainstream corporate leadership, not just a social responsibility.

evidence.description: Announcement describing The Valuable 500 as a global CEO collective for disability business inclusion.

entities.name: Maximus UK — Employment and Skills
entities.description: UK employment and skills provider whose Remploy URL now redirects to Maximus UK employment services, including support for people with disabilities, long-term health conditions, and barriers to work.
entities.selectionRationale: Selected for demonstrating practical employment and skills programmes that support people with disabilities, long-term health conditions, and other barriers to work.
entities.contributionSummary: Provides tailored employment support, skills and qualifications programmes, workplace mental health support, and Access to Work-related services.
entities.insights: Shows how employability support can combine job search help, skills development, workplace adjustments, and health-related support to help people find and remain in work.

evidence.description: Current public page reached from the Remploy URL, describing employment and skills programmes including support for people with disabilities, long-term health conditions, and barriers to work.

entities.name: Inclusive Arts Collective CIC
entities.description: UK community interest company creating neurodivergent-led arts programmes for children and young people through movement, visual arts, performance, and sensory expression.
entities.selectionRationale: Selected for showing how neurodivergent-led creative programmes can support confidence, self-expression, belonging, and public understanding of neurodivergence.
entities.contributionSummary: Creates workshops, exhibitions, films, and sensory-based arts programmes co-designed or led with neurodivergent artists and educators.
entities.insights: Demonstrates that creative expression, sensory exploration, and cultural participation are meaningful contribution pathways for neurodivergent and marginalised young people.

evidence.description: Official site describing neurodivergent-led arts programmes, co-designed workshops, and creative projects.

entities.name: International Paralympic Committee
entities.description: Global governance body for the Paralympic Movement, demonstrating athletic excellence, international competition, and sports participation by Para athletes.
entities.selectionRationale: Selected for establishing competitive Para sport pathways that demonstrate excellence and capability at world-class level.
entities.contributionSummary: Organizes the Paralympic Games, supports the Paralympic Movement, sets classification standards for Para sport, and promotes social inclusion through sport.
entities.insights: Demonstrates that Para athletes' excellence and achievement are legitimate pathways for contribution, visibility, and social inclusion.

evidence.description: Official Paralympic governance and information.

evidence.sourceTitle: IPC Guide to Para and IPC Terminology
evidence.description: IPC terminology guidance recommending Para athlete or athlete/person with disability instead of disabled athlete.

entities.name: Incluyeme.com
entities.description: Latin American social enterprise promoting socio-labour inclusion of people with disabilities through employability programmes and support for organisations.
entities.selectionRationale: Selected for its public work on socio-labour inclusion of people with disabilities across Latin America, including employability, training, inclusive hiring, and employer support.
entities.contributionSummary: Connects people with disabilities to job opportunities, offers training, and supports companies with inclusive hiring, consulting, and diversity strategies.
entities.insights: Shows that inclusive employment can be built through regional ecosystems that work with both people with disabilities and employers.

evidence.description: Official page describing socio-labour inclusion of people with disabilities and employability work.

evidence.sourceTitle: Incluyeme.com — Work for People with Disabilities
evidence.description: Official page describing job opportunities, training, and partner companies for people with disabilities.

entities.name: Scope — Disability Equality
entities.description: UK disability equality charity campaigning for an equal future with disabled people.
entities.selectionRationale: Selected for disability rights leadership and for advocating systemic changes needed for inclusion beyond individual service provision.
entities.contributionSummary: Runs campaigns for disability equality, provides advocacy and advice services, and conducts research on barriers to disabled people's participation and employment.
entities.insights: Demonstrates that addressing disabled people's contribution requires systemic change and advocacy, not only individual support services.

evidence.description: Official page describing Scope's mission to create an equal future with disabled people.

evidence.sourceTitle: Scope — How We Speak About Disability
evidence.description: Scope language guidance explaining its use of social-model language such as disabled people.
